summary: Phaos Technology Holdings (Cayman) Ltd, a Singapore-based, Cayman-domiciled foreign private issuer, disclosed in a Form 6-K that it entered a securities purchase agreement dated September 28, 2026 with High West Partners LLC. The company may, at its discretion, sell Class A ordinary shares up to the greater of $10,000,000 or a Nasdaq/NYSE Exchange Cap of 19.99% of shares outstanding, plus 36-month availability and $100,000 commitment shares. This is a routine equity line of credit (standby equity purchase facility), not a special situation or M&A event; structurally, it is dilutive at management's discretion and subject to pricing and volume limits.
